verdict.rationale: Algolia documents and ships an official MCP server (algolia-mcp) via the algolia/skills pack, and a runtime probe confirms a live hosted MCP endpoint (mcp.algolia.com/mcp) that correctly implements MCP's OAuth-protected-resource flow. This directly satisfies connecting an agent via an official MCP server, covering search, analytics, and recommendations use cases. Missing for 10: independent third-party hands-on validation of the MCP server beyond the vendor's own probe, and richer docs detailing tool schemas/capabilities exposed via MCP.
